title: Known application immutable artifact declaration
description: Separate local CLI/CI metadata. This is not RegisterBody, registry verification, Docker readiness, or platform digest storage. All three paths used with this input must be absolute, regular/owned local paths without symlink/reparse-point ancestors. Rust additionally checks exact origin, selected application, source/digest consistency, closed journal history, and canonical release definition.

publicOrigin.description: Exact HTTPS origin without trailing slash, credentials, path, query or fragment; explicit development loopback HTTP is the only exception.

identity.description: Lowercase registry/repository and verified distribution manifest digest, never a Docker image/config ID. Rust also validates registry and repository components.
Fixed canonical public source artifact coordinate without credentials/query/fragment. Its actual canonical resource manifest digest must be verified by CI; a URL hash is not artifact identity.
